These eastern and western survey forms fit that r-retaining cār/cyār series, with regional affricate/sibilant outcomes. Classifier-bearing responses are excluded. The specific neuter-plural subsection is used rather than the article head.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly lists alag/ālag separate across Hindi, Nepali, Bengali, Oriya and other regional languages under alagna, through Prakrit alagga. The whole alog/alug responses preserve that stem with local vowels. Reduplicated forms and alādā-like loans with d are excluded from this simple reflex rule.
